name: Archipelago
description: Connects Super Mario Galaxy to an Archipelago multiworld through the Super Mario Galaxy client. Does nothing until a seed is received.

options.name: Archipelago
options.description: Off: the mod does nothing at all.

options.name: Client Port
options.description: The local port of the Super Mario Galaxy client (its --port).

options.name: Connection Messages
options.description: On: a message when the game finds or loses the Archipelago client, and when the client joins or leaves a multiworld.
